import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_31/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_31/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history: JOIN on ["city", "city"]
# Join df0 and df1 on the "city" column
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Target schema: ['type': string, 'city': string, 'fare': float, 'ride_id': float, 'driver_count': integer]
# Select and reorder columns accordingly
# Also ensure data types match target schema

# Convert columns to target types explicitly
df_result = pd.DataFrame()
df_result['type'] = df_joined['type'].astype(str)
df_result['city'] = df_joined['city'].astype(str)
df_result['fare'] = df_joined['fare'].astype(float)
df_result['ride_id'] = df_joined['ride_id'].astype(float)
df_result['driver_count'] = df_joined['driver_count'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_31/target_multisource.csv"
df_result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 as per hint 21
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_31/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_31/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join by default)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by the leftmost non-float unique columns in target schema:
# target schema: ['type': string, 'city': string, 'fare': float, 'ride_id': float, 'driver_count': integer]
# Group by: type, city, driver_count (all non-float, and city is key)
# Aggregate fare and ride_id by mean (to reduce duplicates and match target float values)
grouped = joined.groupby(["type", "city", "driver_count"], as_index=False).agg({
    "fare": "mean",
    "ride_id": "mean"
})

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
result = grouped[["type", "city", "fare", "ride_id", "driver_count"]]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_31/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
